passage_requests.question: What are the Appendix A one-loop wave-function counterterms for Higgs, lepton doublet and sterile neutrino, the Higgs mass counterterm, neutrino Yukawa and Majorana mass counterterms in the renormalizable limit where all dimension-five and redundant coefficients vanish? Also identify epsilon=(4-d)/2 and UV/IR rearrangement conventions.

What renormalization conventions distinguish bare wave-function and parameter counterterms from one-loop beta functions? Identify the scheme, dimension convention, role of tadpoles and broken-phase mass/mixing basis, and any Higgs mass or neutrino Yukawa beta comparisons with the unbroken type-I seesaw.

Locate Appendix D.1 equations D33b and D33c for Majorana mass and neutrino Yukawa beta functions in the extended Standard Model. What is the source convention and matrix orientation in the Yukawa Lagrangian and Majorana mass term?

beta_comparison.claim_limit: Standard renormalizable pure-Y contributions in stated conventions.

external_C7_field_part.claim_limit: Only external-field factors; not the full dimension-seven coefficient, proper vertex or anomalous-dimension matrix.

limitations: Only named body sections were reviewed. No complete paper or supplement was exhaustively checked.
The AppendixA formulas were read in the saved primary HTML; passage-index results alone did not return all of Eq58.
Most search results were screened only from metadata/abstracts.
No full broken-to-unbroken parameter/tadpole/mixing conversion or finite matching of2507.21691 was performed.
Published counterterms check consistency; packet self-energy and proper-vertex diagram calculations are separate artifacts.
A scaleless dimensionally regulated integral is not by itself evidence for a zero UV pole.
External-field-only C7 running is not a complete physicalC7 beta function.
